I am an old woman here in Dedza, and this small maize plot must feed my family. I will try hard to get a FISP coupon this year because without it I cannot afford fertilizer at the market price — if I receive it I will use the NPK at planting and urea as topdressing. I also spread the manure from my few chickens and goats because it helps the soil, and I intercrop with beans and pumpkin as we always do. I cannot afford pesticides or to hire much labor; my daughter and I will do the weeding ourselves, maybe paying a neighbor for one or two days at weeding time if the rains make the weeds heavy.
